def factor_volume_transition_gap_stress_carry_ema30(df):
    """Smoothed directional carry from EMA-defined high-volume transitions with overnight-stress attenuation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(volume, window=20)
    active = is_high_vol > 0
    prior_active = active.shift(1).fillna(False)
    transition = (active & ~prior_active).astype(float)
    close_return = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    transition_return = transition * close_return
    event_count = transition.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum()
    carried_return = transition_return.rolling(30, min_periods=30).sum() / (1.0 + event_count)
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    overnight_downside = overnight_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
    intraday_downside = intraday_ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2)
    total_energy = (overnight_downside + intraday_downside).rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum()
    overnight_concentration = overnight_downside.rolling(20, min_periods=20).sum() / total_energy.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    stress = overnight_concentration * np.sqrt(total_energy)
    factor = carried_return / (1.0 + 5.0 * stress)
    return factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).rename("factor_volume_transition_gap_stress_carry_ema30")
rationale: Mutates the qualified parent's volume-transition carry by replacing the rolling-median activity state with the reusable EMA-based volume-regime transition module. The 30-bar carry horizon and overnight downside-stress attenuation are preserved to retain the parent's positive cost-adjusted payoff, monotonicity, and lower turnover. The targeted bottleneck is predictive robustness, especially the relatively modest IC and MI: an EMA-relative threshold should define participation transitions more consistently across changing volume scales without adding a second economic signal.
